summary: Keene's Beech Hill: an 1890 observation tower is gone; the summit now has communication towers and an old foundation.

facts.design: Wooden observation tower, 35 ft (10.7 m), built 1890 as the Horatian Tower
facts.status_note: The 1890 observation tower is gone; the summit now has communication towers. A 2026 hike report gives conflicting statements on whether the area is fenced in.

access.note: Beech Hill Preserve open space with trails (Keene Sentinel; 2026 hike report). The 2026 report says everything is fenced in, but also that the old tower area is not fenced off.

visit.trail_note: Trails run through the preserve; a 2026 hike report lists parking for 2-4 cars. No tower stands to climb.

corrections.why: The Forest Fire Lookout Association files this Beech Hill under 'Lookout Sites / Non-lookout Structures' as an 'Obs Tower'; the 1890 Horatian Tower was an observation tower. NH Family Hikes still lists a Beech Hill (Keene) fire tower site, so a human should decide whether the record stays a fire lookout.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: One eastern lookout page reads 'New Hampshire - Coos County'. The register, the Keene Sentinel and NH Family Hikes place Beech Hill in Keene, Cheshire County.

sources.title: A moment in local history: The Horatian Tower, by Alan F. Rumrill

notes_for_editor: Sources disagree on what stood on the summit. The 1890 Horatian Tower was an observation tower (Keene Sentinel). NH Family Hikes lists a Beech Hill (Keene) fire tower site at 1,053 ft, and the 2026 hike report describes a fire tower site with an old foundation, but no source dates a fire tower here. Staffing and fire history: nothing found, so none written. The 2026 hike report says the old tower area 'is not fenced off' and later that 'everything is fenced in'; the story now reports both statements and flags the conflict. An eastern lookout page reads Coos County; discounted. A different Beech Hill in Dublin (Cheshire County, about 1,880 ft, former fire tower site per NH Family Hikes) is a separate summit and not this record.
